newsitem.title: UK: BT may enter German Kirch Group venture - FT.
newsitem.headline: BT may enter German Kirch Group venture - FT.

text.p: British Telecommunications is in detailed negotiations with the Kirch group to launch interactive services using digital satellite television in Germany, the Financial Times said.
The paper said the move could bring BT into direct competition in the German market with Deutsche Telekom, the operator that is to be privatised in November.
It said the talks between BT and Kirch would involve a joint venture with DF1, the digital satellite company that launched 19 channnels of digital television in July.
BSkyB, the UK satellite group, has a 49 percent stake in DF1 and talks between BSkyB and BT on the launch of digital satellite television in Britain would provide a model, the paper said.
